summary: ```# Marvelous Designer 12 New Feature Demonstration: Retopology Optimization ## Introduction In this video, we explore the new retopology features in Marvelous Designer 12. The focus is on optimizing the retopology process for better efficiency and precision. ## Accessing the Retopology Tools In the toolbar, you can find the tool group for retopology. Click on the scissors icon to view the list of available tools. ## Smart Retopo Features Now, when creating a smart retopo, it can be absorbed into the inner line or the inner shape. The assist retopo point can now appear on the internal line of the retopo. Just like the awl curve, the smart retopo can now be absorbed into the 凸 curve. ## Resulting Retopo Lines The retopo line created can now be absorbed into the inner line and the inner shape, providing a more coherent structure. This is the result of the retopo process. ## Tool Usage Shortcuts To enhance your workflow, use the Y and U keys to quickly switch between the edit tool and the create tool. ### Create Tool Functions - Use the create tool in conjunction with the Ctrl and Shift keys to add a row that separates the top face. - Create a top point on the top face that has already been established, and then proceed to cut the top face. ## Editing Tools Utilize the edit tool to drag the mouse for selecting or canceling the selection of a point. This functionality allows for precise adjustments during the retopology process. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching! We hope you found this demonstration helpful. See you in the next video! ```
